hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: run /capture to save durable knowledge (CLAUDE.md/memory) before context is compacted."}'

for t in $(git tag -l 'edit-start-*' 2>/dev/null); do n=${t#edit-start-}; f=$(ls Chapters/${n}_*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "Editing pass open on chapter $n (${f:-file not found}), tag $t. A fix Bruce asks for without naming a file refers to this chapter first. Close the pass with /edit-done $n."; done; true
